venues.name: Gran's kitchen table
venues.blurb: 2p blinds. Gran's been playing since 1961. Auntie Carol never bluffs. Maureen from bingo calls everything.
talk: Gran: 'I'll see your 4p and raise you a Werther's Original.'
Maureen: 'Is a flush the one with the same colours?'
Auntie Carol: 'I fold. I always fold. I'm folding.'
Gran: 'Your grandad lost the car to me in 1974. Twice.'

venues.name: Big Lee's card night
venues.news: CARD SHARP: {NAME} IN SECRET GAMBLING DEN
venues.blurb: Lee's back room. Smells of Lynx and microwave pizza. Don't stare at Tel's eyebrow.
talk: Big Lee: 'House rules: no crying, no cheating, no asking about the van.'
Tel's eyebrow twitches. Is that a tell? Is the eyebrow the tell?
Mystery Steve hasn't said a word in three hours.

venues.name: Grosvenor Royale Casino
venues.blurb: Carpet with a pattern designed to make you forget what time it is. It works.
talk: The dealer has seen you play. The dealer has seen everything.
A man at the bar is explaining his 'system'. His system is losing.
